proposals.name: 01-compact-card
proposals.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished design proposal for the Cody Companion main Home UI on a circular 466x466 AMOLED. Reference image role: preserve the EXACT existing pearlescent pastel cloud mascot identity, face, colors and smooth material; its caption/footer and existing token typography are not an edit target. Show a single perfectly circular black display face-on centered on a square charcoal design canvas, no hands, room, desk or smartwatch strap. Treat all UI positions as scaled logical 466 coordinates; keep information inside the circle, use its central320x320 safe area. This is an illustrative proposed future UI, not a real screen capture. Keep mascot prominent and friendly, do not replace it with another character or a generic assistant orb. Crisp readable English printable ASCII sans-serif text, refined spacing, high contrast, restrained mint/cyan accents, charcoal surfaces, flat/delicate native-renderable vector-like shapes. Do not put any text outside the circle or add a product logo, price or decorative meaningless statistics. Model and timer are secondary. Compact token unit is exactly uppercase TT, thousands exactly uppercase K. Use sample values Free319K, Last155K, Window475K consistently; do not invent other token counts.
Variant 1: Quiet compact card. Upper third: mascot. Below it medium centered headline "Working". Small secondary line "gpt-6-astra". Lower central area: a rounded charcoal capsule, thin mint border, a restrained small stacked-token glyph on its left and large clean text "Free 319K TT" centered. Under the capsule a thin horizontal context-capacity bar filled one third, muted gray remainder. A small secondary row "Window 475K TT" on the left and "00:12" right. Footer restrained text "Available commands" then "Change my name". Excellent 466px-screen legibility, no tiny labels, avoid sci-fi/HUD styling. All occupied bounds fit circle. Only those exact quoted text strings.
